decision: Owned-Xvfb RED-v3 proves core FocusOut at acquisition. Under the existing canonical KDE desktop resolution only, activate/direct the same owned replay master to the concrete existing client focus before freezing the original master. Reuse existing ReplayMaster/Input cleanup for prepared-but-not-grabbed failure as well. Other desktop ordering, all actual grab/held-key/pending/map/focus/epoch checks and the exact executor/lease remain unchanged. The new KDE leaf owns this policy and checked private-focus operation; no new text owner, output or fallback.
reason: Same-process Firefox active composition toggles correctly; after Space, a complete exact lease becomes unknown-context across native input acquisition before any layout or output. KWin observes the unchanged window. Existing native thaw focus protection and incomplete freeze assertion identify a bounded mechanism to test, not yet a certified root cause.
verification: Genuine owned-Xvfb core-focus RED before implementation; then unchanged focus/held-key/map/isolation/queued-input guards and native suite, affected daemon source tests, warning-free build and matching idle daemon bytes. Short same-process native active/Space/Tab controls, with GNOME and all other processes/config preserved. Keep all FAIL/BLOCKED receipts.
not_tested: Strengthened freeze test has genuine RED-v3; two earlier test setup errors are not evidence. Runtime implementation, failure cleanup and native acceptance pending; no new runtime installed by this decision.
